Laravel; follow existing conventions. Versions: inertiajs/inertia-laravel v2, laravel/fortify v1, laravel/framework v12, laravel/prompts v0, laravel/wayfinder v0, laravel/boost v2, laravel/mcp v0, laravel/pail v1, laravel/pint v1, laravel/sail v1, pestphp/pest v4, phpunit/phpunit v12.

Activate `wayfinder-development` when referencing backend routes in frontend components or using Wayfinder route functions. Activate `pest-testing` for tests, assertions, test failures, or when the user mentions test, spec, TDD, expects, assertion, coverage, or verification.

Follow conventions; check sibling files, reuse components, use descriptive names, and keep existing structure. Do not change the application's dependencies without approval. You must only create documentation files if explicitly requested by the user. Do not create verification scripts or tinker when tests cover that functionality and prove they work. Be concise.

Use Laravel Boost MCP tools. Use `list-artisan-commands` for Artisan options; `get-absolute-url` for project URLs; `tinker` for PHP debugging/Eloquent queries; `database-query` for database reads; `database-schema` before migrations/models; `browser-logs` for browser errors (ignore old logs). Search docs before changes: ALWAYS use `search-docs` for version-specific Laravel, Inertia, and Pest docs. Pass known package arrays; use broad, simple topic queries. Do not add package names to queries.

Always use curly braces for control structures. Use PHP 8 constructor property promotion. Do not allow empty `__construct()` methods with zero parameters unless the constructor is private. Always use explicit return types and parameter type hints. Prefer PHPDoc over inline comments. Never use comments within the code itself unless the logic is exceptionally complex. Add useful array shape types; enum keys are typically TitleCase.

You must not run any commands to make the site available via HTTP(S). Herd URL: `https?://[kebab-case-project-dir].test`. If frontend changes aren't reflected, ask the user to run `npm run build`, `npm run dev`, or `composer run dev`.

Every change must be programmatically tested. Write or update a test, then run affected tests; run the minimum needed with `php artisan test --compact` and a filename or filter.

Inertia pages: `resources/js/pages` unless `vite.config.js` says otherwise. Use `Inertia::render()`, v1/v2 features, and docs. Deferred props need an empty state with a pulsing or animated skeleton.

Use `php artisan make:` for Laravel files; `php artisan make:class` for generic PHP classes. Pass `--no-interaction` to all Artisan commands and correct `--options`. Use typed Eloquent relationships; prefer models/relationships over raw queries, avoid `DB::`, eager-load to prevent N+1s, and use the query builder for very complex operations. For new models, add useful factories/seeders and ask whether anything else is needed; check `php artisan make:model` options with `list-artisan-commands`. APIs default to versioned Eloquent Resources unless existing conventions differ. Always create Form Request classes for validation instead of inline controller validation; include rules/custom messages and check sibling requests. Use Laravel auth/authorization, named routes and `route()`, and queued jobs (`ShouldQueue`) for long operations.
